𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗨𝟭𝟵 𝗦𝗘𝗠𝗜-𝗙𝗜𝗡𝗔𝗟! 🇮🇳

India U19 face unbeaten Afghanistan U19 in the U19 Asia Cup semi-final today in Oman.
Sehwag's 160 sent India through.

Final spot on the line 👇

#U19AsiaCup #Cricket

👉 U19 Asia Cup semi-final mein India U19 ka muqabla unbeaten Afghanistan U19 se, Al Amerat (Oman) mein
👉 UAE ke khilaf Aaryavir Sehwag ke 160 ne India ko 70 run se jeet dilayi
👉 Jeetne wali team final mein, jo 14 Nov ko hai
